{"metadata":{"description":"小六壬占卜 + DeepSeek Harness 插件（时间/报数/随机起卦，结论优先）","id":"gh:1336135419","install_available":false,"language":"TypeScript","name":"xiaoliuren","slug":"shuimo07/xiaoliuren","topics":["dsh-plugin"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"小六壬占卜 + DeepSeek Harness 插件（时间/报数/随机起卦，结论优先）"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# xiaoliuren · Xiao Liu Ren divination (dsh-plugin-xiaoliuren)"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"A **Xiao Liu Ren (小六壬)** divination project: cast a reading via **time / numbers / random**, and get"},{"id":"p3s2","text":" a **conclusion-first** plain-language verdict plus the six-palace layout, auspiciousness, five elem"},{"id":"p3s3","text":"ents, direction, celestial spirit and verse. It works standalone (library + CLI) and also ships as a"},{"id":"p3s4","text":" DeepSeek Harness (DSH) tool plugin (tool name `xiaoliuren`). Every result carries a disclaimer — en"},{"id":"p3s5","text":"tertainment/traditional-culture reference only."},{"id":"p4s1","text":"▶ **Live demo**: (GitHub Pages — open it in any browser)"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"## Features"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"- Three casting modes: `time` (solar/lunar), `numbers` (1–3 numbers), `random` (seeded & reproducibl"},{"id":"p6s2","text":"e) - **Conclusion-first**: plain-language verdict + advice, then layout details - `question` is echo"},{"id":"p6s3","text":"ed in the conclusion and never affects the math - Configurable: calendar, `lateZiShiRollover`, discl"},{"id":"p6s4","text":"aimer text, random source - **Zero-dependency core** (`src/core/` is pure functions; lunar calendar "},{"id":"p6s5","text":"uses a built-in compact table) - **Install-and-run**: committed `lib/` output, loaded by DSH via `ma"},{"id":"p6s6","text":"ompact table) - **Install-and-run**: committed `lib/` output, loaded by DSH via `main: lib/index.js`"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## Build & test"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"Requires Node ≥ 18 (Node 22 recommended) and pnpm."},{"id":"p10s1","text":"## Library usage"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"Public API: `castTime`, `castNumbers`, `castRandom`, `compute`, `advance`, `renderSteps`, `getPalace"},{"id":"p12s2","text":"`, `PALACES`, `shichenFromHour`, `shichenName`, `solarToLunar`, `makeRng`, and all types."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"## CLI usage"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"Invalid input prints a Chinese error and exits non-zero. Default output is the conclusion-first card"},{"id":"p15s2","text":"nvalid input prints a Chinese error and exits non-zero. Default output is the conclusion-first card:"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"## The six palaces"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"| # | Palace | Fortune | Element | Direction | Spirit |"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"| 1 | 大安 Dà'ān | auspicious | Wood | East | Azure Dragon | | 2 | 留连 Liúlián | inauspicious | Water |"},{"id":"p19s2","text":" South | Dark Warrior | | 3 | 速喜 Sùxǐ | auspicious | Fire | South | Vermilion Bird | | 4 | 赤口 Chìkǒu"},{"id":"p19s3","text":" | inauspicious | Metal | West | White Tiger | | 5 | 小吉 Xiǎojí | auspicious | Wood | North | Six Har"},{"id":"p19s4","text":"mony | | 6 | 空亡 Kōngwáng | inauspicious | Earth | Center | Gouchen |"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"All palace data lives in `src/core/palaces.ts` (data-as-config): adjust it for school differences, n"},{"id":"p20s2","text":"es in `src/core/palaces.ts` (data-as-config): adjust it for school differences, never the algorithm."},{"id":"p21s1","text":"## Math"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"- Fixed order: 大安(1) → 留连(2) → 速喜(3) → 赤口(4) → 小吉(5) → 空亡(6). - Count months from 大安, days from the "},{"id":"p22s2","text":"month result, hours from the day result; each step counts the current palace as 1 and steps (n−1) fo"},{"id":"p22s3","text":"rward with modulo 6 wrap. - Equivalent formula: `finalIndex = ((month + day + hour - 3) % 6) + 1`. -"},{"id":"p22s4","text":" Shichen mapping: `ordinal = floor(((hour + 1) % 24) / 2) + 1`, 子1 … 亥12, 23:00 wraps to 子."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"## Calendar & late-zi rollover"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"- **Lunar**: `castTime(date, { calendar: 'lunar' })` uses the built-in 1900–2100 compact lunar table"},{"id":"p24s2","text":" (`solarToLunar`; source/scope noted in `src/core/time.ts`). No third-party lunar/date runtime libra"},{"id":"p24s3","text":"ry. - **`lateZiShiRollover`** (default `false`): whether 23:00–23:59 counts as the next day with day"},{"id":"p24s4","text":"+1. v0.1 defaults to no rollover; enabling it advances the day (month/year carry handled by `Date`)."},{"id":"p25s1","text":"## Quick install (one command)"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"Load the plugin into a DSH profile with the bundled installer:"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"The script runs `dsh plugin --profile

add ` and idempotently appends the `tool-xiaoliure"},{"id":"p28s2","text":"n` insert row to the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`. Restart `dsh web` afterwards."},{"id":"p29s1","text":"## Install shortcuts & restart requirement"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"- **Fully restart `dsh web` (stop the process, then start it again). A browser refresh is NOT enough"},{"id":"p30s2","text":".** The client-plugin graph is composed and cached at server boot (package metadata is cached per na"},{"id":"p30s3","text":"me and never expires); only a restart re-scans installed `package.json` files and serves `/plugins/<"},{"id":"p30s4","text":"pkg>/client.js` for packages declaring `exports["./client"]` + `dsh.client`. The host-side `xiaoliur"},{"id":"p30s5","text":"en` tool loads immediately; the **widget is client-side and needs the restart**. Sessions persist in"},{"id":"p30s6","text":" `~/.dsh/sessions`, so the restart does not lose conversations. - **One-command install** (idempoten"},{"id":"p30s7","text":"t): `powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts\install-dsh.ps1` (options: `-Profile`, `-Sourc"},{"id":"p30s8","text":"e file:C:\...`, `-SkipInstall`). The script is Windows PowerShell; macOS/Linux users can follow the "},{"id":"p30s9","text":"three-step manual install below (full restart still required). - **Offline / network-fallback shortc"},{"id":"p30s10","text":"ut**: `dsh plugin --profile web add file:E:\AI\xiaoliuren`. Git deps pin a commit, so after code upd"},{"id":"p30s11","text":"ates run `dsh plugin --profile web update dsh-plugin-xiaoliuren` (or reinstall) and restart. - **Ver"},{"id":"p30s12","text":"ify after restart**: host tool via `dsh --profile web --dump-config | grep -i xiaoliuren`; widget vi"},{"id":"p30s13","text":"a `http://127.0.0.1:3080/plugins/dsh-plugin-xiaoliuren/client.js` → expect 200 (404 = not restarted "},{"id":"p30s14","text":"/ not discovered); the boot manifest `window.__DSH_BOOT__` should list `dsh-plugin-xiaoliuren`."},{"id":"p31s1","text":"## Widget (client UI)"},{"id":"p32s1","text":"The package also ships a **browser-side widget**: a small **卦** button pinned to the app's top-right"},{"id":"p32s2","text":" corner (always visible — even in a brand-new empty session) that collapses into a dot and expands i"},{"id":"p32s3","text":"nto a panel — pick **数字 / 时间 / 随机**, type the 事由 (matter), hit **生成**, and get the conclusion-first "},{"id":"p32s4","text":"result card with the disclaimer. It lives in `lib/client.js` and auto-loads once the package is inst"},{"id":"p32s5","text":"alled and `dsh web` is restarted."},{"id":"p33s1","text":"## DSH integration (three steps)"},{"id":"p34s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p35s1","text":"The plugin exports `{ name: 'tool-xiaoliuren', inject: ['tools', 'systemPrompt'], Config, apply }` a"},{"id":"p35s2","text":"nd registers the `xiaoliuren` tool (parameters: `mode`, `numbers`, `datetime`, `calendar`, `question"},{"id":"p35s3","text":"`; output follows the CastResult JSON schema; render is the conclusion-first text card). Plugin conf"},{"id":"p35s4","text":"ig: `calendar` (solar/lunar), `randomSource` (crypto/math), `disclaimer` (text)."},{"id":"p36s1","text":"## Disclaimer"},{"id":"p37s1","text":"This project and its readings are for **traditional-culture entertainment only** and do not constitu"},{"id":"p37s2","text":"te professional advice of any kind (legal, medical, financial, relationship, etc.)."},{"id":"p38s1","text":"## License"},{"id":"p39s1","text":"MIT"}],"truncated":false}
